items.title: Elf Guiding a Red Ribbon
items.alt: Blond cartoon elf in green clothes seated beside a small wooden loom, guiding a red ribbon over its rollers.
items.description: A long red ribbon curls from the little wooden loom past the elf's pointed shoes. A red bell-tipped cap, embroidered green waistcoat and broad striped stockings frame the seated character.

items.title: Elf Lifting a Snow Globe
items.alt: White-haired cartoon elf lifting a clear snow globe above a decorated green Christmas-tree base.
items.description: The elf carefully holds a snowy globe containing a tiny house and fir trees. A gap above its separate gold-rimmed tree base makes the lifting action easy to see.

items.title: Elf Painting a Red Sled
items.alt: Auburn-pigtailed cartoon elf kneeling beside a red sled with a paintbrush and a small silver paint tin.
items.description: The elf presses a red-tipped brush against the sled's curved runner. Gold bells trim the green cap and capelet, while curled shoes and striped stockings complete the low kneeling pose.

items.title: Elf Ringing Two Handbells
items.alt: Silver-haired cartoon elf in a flared green dress ringing two gold bells while balancing on one foot.
items.description: Raised arms and a lifted shoe give this bell-ringing elf a lively diagonal pose. A gold bow, scalloped dress panels and red shoes distinguish the small Christmas character.

items.title: Elf Playing with Shape Blocks
items.alt: Blue-eyed cartoon elf with silver hair buns sitting beside a wooden shape tray, holding a green cube and red triangle.
items.description: A divided wooden tray holds bright blocks between the elf's outstretched legs. Silver hair buns, a folded red cap and a cream-edged green jacket distinguish the seated figure.

items.title: Elf Singing with a Red Songbook
items.alt: White-haired cartoon elf in a green capelet holding a red book and raising one open hand while singing.
items.description: The elf's open mouth and outstretched hand suggest a cheerful carol. A curled bell-tipped hat, cream piping and layered green hems keep the standing silhouette clear.
